title: The Visits register is never used in a test signed in as the front desk
what: Every screen test of checking members in, removing a check-in, back-dating a day and the Pass visits page signs in as the owner. The desk does this every morning, but no test signs in as desk staff and opens Visits or Losing the habit. Only the menu list for the desk is checked.
expected: At least one screen test signs in as desk staff, checks a member in, undoes it, adds a missed day and opens Losing the habit.
fix_line: Repeat the register test once signed in as desk staff

title: No test checks when the Pass visits button hides or stays
what: The only test taps Pass visits on a gym that has pass members. Nothing checks that a gym with no pass member sees only Check-in QR, that the button appears when the first pass member is added, or that it stays after the last pass member is archived because past visits exist.
expected: A test covers a gym with no pass member, the first pass member added, and the last one archived.
fix_line: Add a short test for the three button states

title: Bring a friend: clearing the days, the one-day wording and the greyed Save are never tested
what: The test sets 7 free days and checks one wrong number. It never clears the box back to none, never saves 1 day (where the toast must say "1 free day"), never checks that Save greys when nothing changed, and never checks the card is hidden on a gym that is not online.
expected: The test also saves an empty box (reads "None"), saves 1 day, checks the greyed Save and the offline gym.
fix_line: Add the empty, one-day and no-change steps to the friend test

title: Several register lines are never checked on the Visits screen
what: The register test checks the toast, the today tile and the missed-day strip. It never checks that the search box empties, that the member shows under "In today", the other three tiles, "Nobody matches that" with "Open Members" on the register, or the batch list for a missed day with its A to Z order.
expected: The register test checks these lines too.
fix_line: Add these checks to the existing register test
